name: Dub
tagline: Audio in — revoice each speaker with the TTS voice you pick.
author: Switchboard
inside: Transcribes locally (whisper/STT on the daemon) — your audio never leaves the machine
Claude splits the transcript into a per-speaker, ordered script (the daemon does not diarize)
Pick a local TTS voice per speaker (cloned voices in ~/.relay/voices, or the OS engine) and regenerate one stitched track
